svg.desc: Color grouped ER diagram of profile, resume, opportunity and user state tables, with their fields, key types and foreign key relationships.
svg.text: Entity relationship diagram · schema tables, key columns, and ownership links
Clerk provides user identity. Every Supabase row is scoped by clerk_user_id + RLS. S3 stores resume file bytes; Supabase stores structured content and metadata.
S3 key reference · not a database FK
